display_name: GPIM variant: pure BEA 2011 reference regenerator

triage.reason: Methodology variant of XS004 (NOT used by S601-S604) that re-derives the official BEA 2011 net stock from the pure GPIM rule, verifying ~99.6% accuracy of the accumulation rule (Appendix Table 6.8.II.1). Publishes because it documents the GPIM-rule validation Shaikh relies on and renders sensibly once units are split: XS005-C is the GPIM/BEA ratio (~1.0), which must not share the billions axis with the two stock columns (latent mixed-units, fixed here per UNITS_VALIDATION_STANDARD).

XS005-A.label: Net current-cost corporate stock (pure GPIM, BEA 2011 inputs)
